theorems.name: Submission.iwl_rl_massOn_iUnion_monotone
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (O : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) → Monotone O → T.massOn (⋃ i, O i) = ⨆ i, T.massOn (O i)
